title: Al-Qadr 97:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Qadr, Al-'Alaq 1 to 12 and the noon sakinah rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Qadr 97:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 9. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ (١) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ (٢) لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ (٣)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Say the noon clearly before the hamza
The qaf has sukoon, so it bounces
The noon is hidden with a light hum

keywords.def: the Decree: the name of the surah

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Qadr 97:1-3 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 97:1-3 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 97:1-3 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, write what 'Laylat al-Qadr' means in your own words.
questions.a: The Night of Decree: the night the Qur'an was first sent down, better than a thousand months.

questions.q: Find the word in 97:1 with a qalqalah letter. Why does it bounce?
questions.a: ٱلْقَدْرِ: the qaf (ق) has a sukoon, so it bounces.

questions.q: Which ayah says the Night of Decree is better than a thousand months?
questions.a: A) 97:3. 97:3 says it is better than a thousand months. 97:1 says the Qur'an was sent down on it; 97:2 asks what will make you know it.

questions.q: Al-Qadr 97:3: «لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Why might one special night be better than a thousand months?
questions.a: Allah chose it: the Qur'an was first sent down on it, and good deeds on it are worth more than a thousand months (97:3).
